_provenance: Sub-rung of ground terrain — grain-scale sand. Decomposes the 2-material terrain into individual grain physics. GPU-accelerated via matter_gpu.
name: grain_scale_sand
walls: Grain size must follow a power law distribution with exponent -2.5 to -3.0
Packing density must be 55-65% (random close packing)
Angle of repose must be 30-40 degrees at grain scale
At least 2 grain types must segregate (coarse vs fine) via differential adhesion
Footstep displacement must be 0.1-1.0mm per step at human walking speed

output.format: grain size distribution, packing density, repose angle per grain type
